2025_327_august_2025_financial_statement.paragraph: Unaudited statements of revenues and expenditures for the Troy School District covering the period July 1, 2025 through August 31, 2025, carried on the Board of Education agenda of October 14, 2025. Nine fund statements are presented — General Fund, Consolidated Debt Service Funds, Troy Preschool Fund (531), Community Service Fund (530), Troy Career Center Fund (529), Food Service Fund (520), Sinking Fund (498), 2023 Capital Projects Fund (423) and 2019 Capital Projects Fund (419) — each showing an approved budget column against actual year-to-date amounts. In the General Fund, actual revenues of $7,332,636 trailed actual expenditures of $27,813,675 for a shortfall of $20,481,039, reflecting that no State or Federal aid had yet been posted two months into the fiscal year.
2025_327_august_2025_financial_statement.page:
**What it is**
Unaudited Statements of Revenues and Expenditures for the Troy School District for the period July 1, 2025 through August 31, 2025, the second month of the 2025-26 fiscal year, presented to the Board of Education on October 14, 2025. Each statement shows an approved budget column and an actual column.

**General Fund**
Budgeted revenues total $190,545,983: Local Sources $47,484,756, State Sources $123,879,792, Federal Sources $4,617,113, and Transfers In and Other $14,564,324. Actual revenues through August 31 were $7,332,636, consisting of $7,315,235 in Local Sources and $17,401 in Interdistrict Sources; no State, Federal, or Transfers In receipts had been recorded.

Budgeted expenditures total $194,285,613 against actual expenditures of $27,813,675. Total Instruction is budgeted at $123,615,219 with $17,462,508 spent (Basic Programs $91,715,371 / $13,468,832; Added Needs $30,930,228 / $3,957,607; Adult Education $969,620 / $36,069). Total Support Services is budgeted at $69,819,768 with $10,322,941 spent, including Operations $15,811,567 / $2,463,212, Pupil $15,850,349 / $2,219,888, Instructional Staff $10,854,009 / $2,201,297, School Administration $10,316,176 / $1,312,529, Central Services $3,723,546 / $966,883, Athletics and Other $2,927,106 / $448,749, General Administration $2,321,066 / $329,699, Business Services $1,771,358 / $283,876, and Pupil Transportation $6,244,591 / $96,809. Community Services is $196,143 / $2,608, Debt Service $650,497 / $25,618, and Outgoing Transfers/Other $3,986 with nothing spent. Revenues Over (Under) Expenditures is budgeted at ($3,739,630) and actual at ($20,481,039).

**Notable items**
The Consolidated Debt Service Funds had received $5,437,100 in local property tax revenue while the only expenditure recorded was $300 in Other Transactions; budgeted Principal of $22,480,000 and Interest of $9,588,536 were untouched. The 2023 Capital Projects Fund (423) shows the largest spending of the non-General funds, $7,486,412, made up of $7,417,775 in capital outlay, $37,937 in purchased services and $30,701 in outgoing transfers, against no recorded revenue and a budgeted deficit of ($63,067,533). The Sinking Fund (498) was the only fund with actual revenues exceeding actual expenditures other than debt service, collecting $846,251 in local sources against $644,388 of capital outlay. The 2019 Capital Projects Fund (419) recorded no revenue and no expenditures.
2025_327_august_2025_financial_statement.verbose:
Unaudited Statements of Revenues and Expenditures for the Troy School District covering the period July 1, 2025 through August 31, 2025, presented on the Board of Education agenda of October 14, 2025 as the August 2025 financial statement. Nine separate fund statements are included, each formatted with an approved budget column and an actual year-to-date column for the first two months of the 2025-26 fiscal year. Because state aid payments and most federal reimbursements had not yet been recorded, actual revenues across most funds are minimal relative to budget while payroll-driven expenditures had begun.

**General Fund — revenues.** The approved budget anticipates Local Sources of $47,484,756, State Sources of $123,879,792, Federal Sources of $4,617,113, no budgeted Interdistrict Sources, and Transfers In and Other of $14,564,324, for total budgeted revenues of $190,545,983. Actual receipts through August 31, 2025 were $7,315,235 from Local Sources and $17,401 from Interdistrict Sources, with nothing posted from State Sources, Federal Sources, or Transfers In and Other, producing total actual revenues of $7,332,636. State Sources, by far the largest budgeted revenue category, remained entirely unrecorded at this point in the year.

**General Fund — instruction expenditures.** Basic Programs are budgeted at $91,715,371 with $13,468,832 expended; Added Needs at $30,930,228 with $3,957,607 expended; and Adult Education at $969,620 with $36,069 expended. Total Instruction is budgeted at $123,615,219 against actual spending of $17,462,508.

**General Fund — support services expenditures.** Pupil support is budgeted at $15,850,349 with $2,219,888 spent; Instructional Staff $10,854,009 with $2,201,297; General Administration $2,321,066 with $329,699; School Administration $10,316,176 with $1,312,529; Business Services $1,771,358 with $283,876; Operations $15,811,567 with $2,463,212; Pupil Transportation $6,244,591 with $96,809; Central Services $3,723,546 with $966,883; and Support Services (Athletics and Other) $2,927,106 with $448,749. Total Support Services is budgeted at $69,819,768 with actual spending of $10,322,941. Pupil Transportation stands out as barely drawn upon, consistent with buses not operating through the summer months, while Central Services shows a comparatively heavy early draw.

**General Fund — remaining categories and bottom line.** Community Services is budgeted at $196,143 with $2,608 spent; Debt Service at $650,497 with $25,618 spent; and Outgoing Transfers/Other at $3,986 with nothing spent. Total Expenditures are budgeted at $194,285,613 with $27,813,675 actual. Revenues Over (Under) Expenditures is budgeted at ($3,739,630) for the full year and stands at ($20,481,039) on an actual basis through August 31, 2025 — expenditures well ahead of receipts because the state aid stream had not begun.

**Consolidated Debt Service Funds.** Local Sources are budgeted at $31,855,092 with $5,437,100 actually received; State Sources are budgeted at $0 with nothing received. Total budgeted revenues are $31,855,092 against actual revenues of $5,437,100. On the expenditure side, Principal is budgeted at $22,480,000 and Interest at $9,588,536, neither of which had been paid, and Other Transactions are budgeted at $2,000 with $300 recorded. Total budgeted expenditures are $32,070,536 against $300 actual. Revenues Over (Under) Expenditures is budgeted at ($215,444) and actual at $5,436,800, reflecting summer tax collections received in advance of the district's debt payment dates.

**Special Revenue Fund — Troy Preschool Fund (531).** Local Sources are budgeted at $1,840,869 with $108,817 received; State Sources at $2,983,078 with nothing received. Total budgeted revenues are $4,823,947 against $108,817 actual. Expenditures: Salaries $1,767,933 budget / $271,219 actual; Employee Benefits $947,179 / $124,446; Purchased Services $1,015,453 / $56,752; Supplies and Materials $514,073 / $19,817; Capital Outlay $127,500 with nothing spent; Other $6,370 / $2,013; Debt Service $493,465 with nothing spent; and Outgoing Transfers $500,000 with nothing transferred. Total budgeted expenditures are $5,371,973 against $474,247 actual. Revenues Over (Under) Expenditures is budgeted at ($548,026) and actual at ($365,430).

**Special Revenue Fund — Community Service Fund (530).** Local Sources are budgeted at $2,269,155 with $248,495 received and State Sources at $2,942 with nothing received, for total budgeted revenues of $2,272,097 and actual revenues of $248,495. Expenditures: Salaries $793,392 budget / $114,924 actual; Employee Benefits $405,531 / $57,732; Purchased Services $1,029,377 / $100,915; Supplies and Materials $57,165 / $9,248; Capital Outlay $5,150 with nothing spent; Other with no budget and no spending; Debt Service with no amounts; and Outgoing Transfers $200,000 with nothing transferred. Total budgeted expenditures are $2,490,615 against $282,819 actual. Revenues Over (Under) Expenditures is budgeted at ($218,518) and actual at ($34,324).

**Special Revenue Fund — Troy Career Center Fund (529).** State Sources are budgeted at $598,948 and Federal Sources at $2,745,238, neither of which had been received; total budgeted revenues are $3,344,186 with no actual revenue recorded. Expenditures: Salaries $1,114,691 budget / $189,800 actual; Employee Benefits $664,977 / $113,027; Purchased Services $1,068,371 / $42,366; Supplies and Materials $13,125 / $1,517; Capital Outlay $8,925 budget with $29,856 already spent, the one line already over its full-year budget; Other $426,846 / $68,151; Debt Service with no amounts; and Outgoing Transfers $47,250 with nothing transferred. Total budgeted expenditures are $3,344,186 against $444,718 actual. Revenues Over (Under) Expenditures is budgeted at $0 — a balanced fund — and stands at ($444,718) actual.

**Special Revenue Fund — Food Service Fund (520).** Local Sources are budgeted at $323,838 with $16,705 received; State Sources at $6,101,199 with nothing received; Federal Sources at $2,231,477 with $182,914 received; and Interdistrict Sources at $718 with nothing received. Total budgeted revenues are $8,657,232 against actual revenues of $199,619. Expenditures: Salaries $99,368 budget / $16,402 actual; Employee Benefits $7,602 / $2,284; Purchased Services $3,724,193 / $232,297; Supplies and Materials $4,552,315 / $13,600; Capital Outlay $1,386,680 with nothing spent; Other $22,800 / $106; and Transfers Out $42,000 with nothing transferred. Total budgeted expenditures are $9,834,958 against $264,688 actual. Revenues Over (Under) Expenditures is budgeted at ($1,177,726) and actual at ($65,069).

**Sinking Fund (498).** Local Sources are budgeted at $5,225,572 with $846,251 received. Capital Outlay is budgeted at $2,125,000 with $644,388 spent. Total Revenue is $5,225,572 budget / $846,251 actual, Total Expenditures $2,125,000 budget / $644,388 actual, and Revenues Over (Under) Expenditures is budgeted at $3,100,572 with $201,863 actual — one of only two funds showing a positive actual balance for the period.

**2023 Capital Projects Fund (423).** Local Sources are budgeted at $3,996,374 with no revenue recorded. Expenditures: Purchased Services $905,393 budget / $37,937 actual; Capital Outlay $65,180,650 budget / $7,417,775 actual; Outgoing Transfers $977,864 budget / $30,701 actual. Total Revenue is $3,996,374 budget with $0 actual; Total Expenditures are $67,063,907 budget with $7,486,412 actual. Revenues Over (Under) Expenditures is budgeted at ($63,067,533) and actual at ($7,486,412). This bond-funded construction fund is by design a spend-down of previously issued proceeds and accounts for the largest non-General Fund outlay in the reporting period.

**2019 Capital Projects Fund (419).** Local Sources are budgeted at $30,000 with nothing received. Capital Outlay is budgeted at $1,034,912 with nothing spent, and Support Services - Central carries no budget and no spending. Total Revenue is $30,000 budget with $0 actual and Total Expenditures $1,034,912 budget with $0 actual. Revenues Over (Under) Expenditures is budgeted at ($1,004,912) with no actual activity, indicating the older 2019 bond program was essentially dormant during July and August 2025.

All statements are marked unaudited and cover the same two-month reporting window ending August 31, 2025.
